intent: Keep the event-table timestamp and the separate overview-time qualification visibly attached to different source treatments. A prominent first-confirmed marker must not hide the reported discrepancy.
source:
**Frame:** Timestamp card `16:07 UTC — FIRST CONFIRMED EXECUTION / OPENAI TECHNICAL EVENT TABLE`. A separate margin note reads `OPENAI OVERVIEW DISPLAYS A LATER RAW-TRACE TIME`.

**Action:** The technical report records the first confirmed OS-command execution on a production worker.

**Provenance:** `documented` + `disputed` — 16:07 from `OAI-TR`; the overview's selected reasoning trace shows a later time and is not silently reconciled.
title: The first confirmed execution is dated and attributed
